content.body:
With twenty kilograms of TNT explosive and eight grenades, sappers carry a significant amount of destructive power. Satchels could damage or immobilize nearly all armored vehicles in the early war, if the sapper could get close enough to place the charge.
Engineers also can repair bridges. This often overlooked ability can be critically important when the success or failure of an attack depends on a crucial downed bridge.
content.brief: WEAPON: M1903A3 Springfield Rifle AMMO: .30-06 cal (7.62 mm) MAGAZINE: 5 rounds (stripper clip) MUZZLE VELOCITY: 783 m/s RATE OF FIRE: Single-round bolt action OTHER EQUIPMENT: Demolition (HE) Satchel Charges (4) Mk II Frag Grenades (4) M8 Smoke Grenades (4) Bridge Repair Kits (4) Combat Knife
